mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 34 degrees under clear skies along the Military Ridge State Trail. The ISS will be visible tonight starting at 7:20 PM as it travels from the west toward the northeast, reaching about halfway up the sky. With a waxing crescent moon, we will see an overnight low of 30 degrees and no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has issued several election notices for the upcoming general and spring elections. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on December 7 to review development projects, including a site plan and conditional use permit for the Sub-Zero expansion at Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do in our community, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Tomorrow, you can catch more music at Lake Lou-ee and Paddy Mac's, and the Dane County Farmers' Market will be open at the Capitol Square.

Regarding local public safety, a noteworthy incident occurred on October 25, when officers responded to a vehicle stopped at an intersection for over 20 minutes, resulting in an O W I arrest of a 40-year-old man.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open, so you have plenty of time to stop by before they close at 10:30 PM tonight.
